claims: The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray is the base model of the C8 generation.
The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray features a mid-mounted 6.2L LT2 V8 engine.
The 6.2L LT2 V8 engine produces 490-495 hp.
The 6.2L LT2 V8 engine produces 465-470 lb-ft of torque.
The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray has a mid-engine rear-wheel-drive layout.
The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray offers coupe and convertible options.
The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray accelerates from 0-60 mph in 2.9 seconds with the Z51 package.
The 6.2L LT2 V8 engine is naturally aspirated.
The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray produces 495 hp with performance exhaust.
The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray produces 470 lb-ft of torque.
The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray has an 8-speed dual-clutch transmission.
The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray has no manual option.
The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray features Weather, Tour, Sport, Track, and MyMode driving modes.
Magnetic Ride Control is available on the 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray.
The coupe version of the 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray has a removable roof panel.
The convertible version of the 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray has a retractable hardtop.
The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray features a 12-inch digital instrument display.
GT2 bucket seats are available on the 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray.
The 3LT trims of the 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray feature extensive leather wrapping.
The 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray offers both front and rear trunks.
The starting MSRP for the 1LT Coupe of the 2025/2026 models is approximately $68,300-$70,195.
The 3LT Convertible of the 2025/2026 models is priced up to $88,945.
